- Eye tests grew 39.8% YoY.

- Strong store expansion continued.
- Revenue growth remained broad-based.

- International business delivered faster growth.

- Strong revenue growth.

- PAT growth remained exceptional.

- Healthy international growth.
- Premiumisation improving ASP.
- Strong store expansion.

Key Concerns

- Maintaining elevated EBITDA margins.
- International expansion execution.

- Revenue growth momentum.
- India SSSG trajectory.
- Store addition pace.
- Product margin sustainability.
- EBITDA margin trajectory.

- India ASP growth.

Impact
- Positive.
- Strong revenue and volume growth.
- Significant margin expansion.
- Premiumisation improving economics.
- Store expansion accelerating growth.
- Cash generation turning stronger.

Key Takeaway
- Lenskart Solutions delivered a strong Q1FY27 with robust revenue, volume and store growth, while EBITDA and PAT expanded sharply. Product margins crossed 70%, premiumisation lifted ASPs, and positive free cash flow with improving ROCE strengthened the financial profile. Continued SSSG, store expansion, premiumisation and international growth remain key drivers, while sustaining elevated margins and execution remain important monitorables.

SEPC Limited | Q1 FY27 Key Highlights

SEPC Limited reported a strong 40% YoY growth in Total Income to ₹282 Cr in Q1 FY27, supported by continued execution across its diversified order book.

• Total Income of ₹282 Cr, up 40% YoY from ₹202 Cr in Q1 FY26

• Orders on hand of ₹10,670 Cr as of June 30, 2026, comprising ₹5,270 Cr domestic and ₹5,400 Cr international order book

Lumax Industries: Guidance - - Concall Update

• Management updated the CapEx guidance for FY27 to INR200 crore to INR250 crore, primarily due to new order wins, an increase from the previously mentioned INR100 crore to INR150 crore.

• The full-year FY27 EBITDA margin forecast remains at 10.5% to 11%, with an endeavor to reach close to 13% EBITDA in a three to four-year horizon, implying approximately a 100 bps annual increase.

• The company is confident in delivering an above-industry revenue CAGR of 15% to 20% over the next three to five years, targeting INR9,000 crore or upwards revenue by FY30-31.

• Mold sales are targeted to be INR250 crore to INR300 crore for the full year, up from INR185 crore last year, with the majority of these revenues planned for H2, specifically Q3 or Q4.

• Localization efforts, particularly in electronics, are expected to increase from the current 40-50% to 70-80% for bare PCBs and from 24% to 40-50% for connectors, potentially yielding a 70 bps to 90 bps margin gain over the next two to three years.

MCX in Focus 

SEBI ON FPI PARTICIPATION IN COMMODITY DERIVATIVES
SEBI proposes allowing FPIs to trade commodity derivatives
Proposal covers non-agri commodities
FPIs may get access to crude oil, natural gas, gold, silver and base metals
FPIs can participate in cash-settled commodity derivatives
Proposal also covers physically settled contracts
However, FPIs will NOT be allowed to take physical delivery
FPIs will have to exit or roll over positions before the delivery period
If positions are not closed or rolled over, they may be transferred to the trading member
Aim: Wider FPI participation and deeper commodity markets

TARC: TO ACQUIRE REMAINING 50% STAKE IN NIBLIC GREENS HOSPITALITY 🏨

• Board approves acquisition of 25,000 equity shares for ₹55 lakh

• Transaction represents the remaining 50% stake in Niblic Greens Hospitality

• Post acquisition, Niblic Greens Hospitality will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of TARC

• Niblic operates in the tourism & accommodation sector, including hotels and motels

• Acquisition expected to be completed on or before March 31, 2027

ZYDUS LIFESCIENCES: PARTNERS WITH SENTYNL FOR ALVELESTAT 💊

• Deal gives Sentynl exclusive US commercialization rights if option is exercised

• Mereo could receive up to $40 Mn in upfront & R&D payments, plus royalties on US sales

• Alvelestat is being prepared for global Phase 3 trials

JBM AUTO, OLECTRA, ASHOK LEYLAND: E-BUS & E-TRUCK PUSH ⚡🚌

• Govt considering interest subvention for electric buses and e-trucks

• Less than 1,000 e-trucks above 3.5-tonne capacity currently in India

• ₹4,391 Cr allocated for 14,028 electric buses under PM E-Drive

• 13,800 e-buses allocated through CESL tenders; 200 to J&K

• Charging proposals worth ₹710-715 Cr approved under PM E-Drive

• Additional ₹190 Cr charging infrastructure proposal under consideration

**CARBORUNDUM UNIVERSAL – MACQUARIE REPORT HIGHLIGHTS**

**Brokerage View**
- U-P maintained
- Target Price: ₹940

**Q1FY27 Performance**
- Revenue grew 17% YoY
- Revenue beat expectations
- Abrasives grew 20% YoY
- Ceramics grew 16% YoY
- Electromineral grew 16% YoY

**Profitability**
- EBITDA grew 11% YoY
- PAT grew 23% YoY
- Both below estimates
- Gross margin fell 350bps

**Margin Pressure**
- Higher input costs impacted margins
- Pricing partly offset cost pressure
- Profitability remains under pressure

**Guidance**
- Revenue guidance raised
- PAT guidance lowered
- Higher costs weigh on outlook
- Overseas closure delays remain concern

**Investment View**
- Revenue growth remains strong
- Margin pressure limits earnings
- Overseas closures key monitorable

**VODAFONE IDEA – JPMORGAN REPORT HIGHLIGHTS**

**Brokerage View**
- UNDERWEIGHT initiated
- Target Price: ₹9

**Q1FY27 Performance**
- Revenue beat estimates
- EBITDA beat estimates
- Revenue +3% QoQ
- EBITDA +3% QoQ
- Margin broadly flat at 43%

**ARPU & Subscribers**
- ARPU +2% QoQ
- ARPU: ₹177 vs ₹176 estimate
- Net adds: 0.3 Mn
- First positive net adds since merger

**Capex**
- Capex: ₹1,930 Cr
- Capex declined 16% QoQ
- Below JPM estimate of ₹2,300 Cr

**Key Concern**
- Bank funding remains unavailable
- Funding crucial for capex
- Funding needed to sustain market share

**Investment View**
- Q1 performance ahead of expectations
- Subscriber additions turning positive
- ARPU growth remains supportive
- Funding remains key stock risk

**VODAFONE IDEA – CLSA REPORT HIGHLIGHTS**

**Brokerage View**
- HOLD maintained
- Target Price: ₹13

**Q1FY27 Performance**
- Revenue: ₹11,680 Cr
- Revenue +3% QoQ / +6% YoY
- EBITDA: ₹5,030 Cr
- EBITDA +3% QoQ / +9% YoY
- EBITDA in line with estimates

**ARPU & Subscribers**
- Mobile ARPU +2% QoQ / +7% YoY
- Subscribers added: 0.3 Mn
- Total subscribers: 193 Mn
- First positive net additions post-merger

**Debt Position**
- Total debt: ₹1.53 lakh Cr
- Spectrum debt: ₹1.30 lakh Cr
- Debt remained stable QoQ

**Capex & Funding**
- Planned investment: ₹45,000 Cr
- Debt funding being pursued
- Funding remains key monitorable

**Investment View**
- Subscriber trend showing improvement
- ARPU growth remains supportive
- Funding remains critical for capex

**VODAFONE IDEA – NOMURA REPORT HIGHLIGHTS**

**Brokerage View**
- NEUTRAL maintained
- Target Price: ₹12.6

**Q1FY27 Performance**
- Results broadly in line
- No major surprises
- 3-year capex program begins

**Key Trigger**
- Debt-capital raise remains crucial
- Successful fundraise could support outlook

**Key Catalysts**
- Successful debt-capital raise
- Industry tariff hikes
- Faster subscriber additions
- Strategic equity investment

**Investment View**
- Funding remains key concern
- Tariff hikes could aid recovery
- Subscriber growth remains monitorable
- Equity capital could boost confidence

**GLAND PHARMA – GOLDMAN SACHS REPORT HIGHLIGHTS**

**Brokerage View**
- SELL maintained
- Target Price: ₹2,125
- Target price raised

**Q1FY27 Performance**
- Sales grew 20% YoY
- EBITDA grew 33% YoY
- EBITDA margin: 27.2%
- Margin expanded 275bps YoY

**Margin Drivers**
- Favourable product mix
- Higher CDMO contribution
- Improved capacity utilisation
- Cost optimisation supported margins

**Business Growth**
- CDMO grew 20% YoY
- B2B grew 19% YoY
- US growth remained strong
- US revenue grew 32% YoY

**FY27 Outlook**
- Q1 growth: 15% constant-currency
- FY27 growth guidance: ≥15% CC
- RTU bag approval could add upside
- Approval expected in 3QFY27

**Valuation**
- Trades at 28x FY28E P/E
- FY26–28E EPS CAGR: 22%
- Valuation seen expensive

**Key Risks**
- Core business margin headwinds
- Cenexi turnaround may take longer
- Pre-acquisition margins may be delayed

**Investment View**
- Strong Q1 execution
- Growth outlook remains healthy
- Valuation limits upside
- Cenexi remains key monitorable

**GLAND PHARMA – JEFFERIES REPORT HIGHLIGHTS**

**Brokerage View**
- BUY upgraded
- Target Price: ₹3,350
- Target price raised

**Q1FY27 Performance**
- Strong beat vs estimates
- US market grew 32% YoY
- US growth drove performance

**FY27 Outlook**
- Growth potential raised to 15% CC
- Earlier guidance: 12–13%
- Growth outlook improving

**Growth Drivers**
- Major CDMO contract signed
- Large TAM product in-licensed
- Complex product expansion underway

**Cenexi Turnaround**
- Cenexi nearing breakeven
- New contract wins supportive
- Operational turnaround progressing

**Investment View**
- Key challenges largely behind
- Complex products offer growth
- CDMO expansion supports upside
- BUY stance strengthened

The Momentum Decoder: Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd (+60% in 1 month)

Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd (NSE:KALYANKJIL) surged after posting a massive 46% jump in quarterly revenue, which triggered aggressive institutional buying despite some minor margin pressure. Smart money completely absorbed the initial post-earnings profit booking near ₹568, driving a sharp volume-backed recovery that pushed the stock to finish strong at ₹610.

Bottom Line: The structural growth is impressive, but chasing a vertical 60% rally leaves no margin of safety; wait for a healthy pullback toward ₹570 before considering new entries.

Yield Spike & Global Impact 🌍

The US 30Yr Treasury yield hit 5.28%, a high unseen since 2007. The US-Iran conflict pushed WTI Crude from $67 to $115/barrel before settling near $76.

Rising crude halted the inflation decline, sparking hawkish Federal Reserve shifts. The 10Yr Treasury yield has strong support at 4.5% and could hit 5%. The Dollar Index remains firm near 98.

Tactical Play: Elevated yields strengthen the USD but crush Gold and emerging equities. Gold ($4,341) faces downside risk to $3,800. The Nifty 50 and Indian Rupee will face bearish corrections.

🎯 Bottom Line: Oil-driven inflation fears have reignited US Treasury yields. Expect a strong US Dollar, capped upside for Gold, and delayed rallies in global equities until yields decisively fall.

NUVAMA ON TITAN

Rating: HOLD (Downgraded from BUY) , Target Price: ₹5,241 (Earlier ₹5,030)

• Q1 FY27 performance was strong with revenue up 36% YoY, EBITDA up 57% and net profit up 65%

• Jewellery revenue grew 43% to ₹15,900 Cr; domestic jewellery revenue rose 38%, with like-for-like growth of 33%

• Jewellery EBIT included an inventory gain of around ₹370 Cr; MTM inventory benefit was around 75–80 bps

• CaratLane revenue grew around 41%; EBIT margin improved sharply to 11.5% from 6.6%

• International jewellery revenue jumped 136%, but the segment reported an ₹8 Cr EBIT loss amid GCC geopolitical disruptions

• Watches and eyewear businesses both grew 22%

• Nuvama expects MTM benefits to moderate over the next 2–3 quarters, while customs-duty benefits could continue for another two quarters

• Despite strong fundamentals, the recent share-price rally has reduced upside potential, prompting the downgrade to HOLD.
